Double Chocolate Cookies 
cookie recipe | dessert basics 

nothing says cheat day like a friday!!
we are making these gooey decadent double chocolate cookies today 

Nutrition: 
C: 38 | F: 15 | P: 4
Calories: 280 per cookie 
Makes 10 cookies

Ingredients 
113 grams butter, room tempreture (salted or unsalted) 
100 grams brown sugar
50 grams caster sugar 
1 egg, room tempreture OR 50 grams thick yogurt 
1 tsp vanilla 

160 grams maida
30 grams cocoa powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp coffee powder
pinch of salt

150 grams dark chocolate chunks 

Method
cream the butter with both the sugar till fluffy 
add in the egg or yogurt and vanilla and mix together 
sift in the flour, cocoa powder, baking soda and coffee powder, a pinch of salt is needed if you arent using salted butter
add in the chopped dark chocolate chunks and combine 
refridgerate the cookie dough for 1 hour minimum upto 24 hours
scoop into balls, you will get around 10 cookies but feel free to use more dough and make 6 chunky and thick cookies
bake at 180 degrees for 10-15 mins, cookies will spread slightly
now the important part - when to take them out 
the cookies should not be fully set they should be slightly set but will still be soft to touch in the oven and once they come out they have more structure as they cool 
the longer you bake the crunchier they will be 
once cooled, store in an airtight container for 2-4 days
